WITH station_data AS (
    SELECT 
        observstation,
        ROUND((atmostransparency * (1 - humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * windspeedms))::numeric, 4) AS aoi,
        lunarstage,
        lunardistdeg,
        solarstatus,
        CASE 
            WHEN (atmostransparency * (1 - humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * windspeedms)) > 0.85
                 AND lunarstage IN ('New', 'First Quarter')
                 AND lunardistdeg > 45
                 AND solarstatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate')
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS good_conditions
    FROM observatories
)
SELECT 
    good_conditions,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count,
    ROUND(AVG(aoi)::numeric, 4) AS avg_aoi,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'station_name', observstation,
            'aoi_value', aoi,
            'lunar_factors', json_build_object(
                'lunar_stage', lunarstage,
                'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg
            ),
            'solar_condition', solarstatus
        )
    ) AS environmental_factors
FROM station_data
GROUP BY good_conditions
ORDER BY good_conditions;
